title: Asia House Fellowship 2027/2028
field: Economic, political and commercial issues in Asia and the Middle East
about: Asia House's 2027/2028 Fellowship supports early-career researchers in a research project on issues driving change across Asia and/or the Middle East. It can be completed remotely and is open to all nationalities.
requirements: A completed Master's and/or PhD by October 2027
In the early stages of their career
Open to people of all nationalities and in all locations
